authorized_scope: S5 UPLOAD KEY CREATION + LOCAL RELEASE SIGNING ONLY
permitted: Create one dedicated developer-held upload keystore locally
Keep keystore and all passwords only on the human-controlled local device
Build a fresh release AAB from the verified source using the already-authorized QA bundleRelease path
Sign the fresh release AAB locally with the dedicated upload key
Record only non-secret metadata: public upload-certificate SHA-256 fingerprint, source commit, AAB SHA-256, byte size, versionName, versionCode, and verification result
prohibited: Committing or uploading the private keystore
Sending private key material or passwords to CHAT
